environment: production cache module with controllable transport

checks.name: instance caches are isolated; TTL returns only fresh data and never uses browser/global storage
parallel StrictMode readers share one fetch; canceling a consumer does not cancel its replacement
logout/account-switch clear aborts old transport and late responses cannot enter another session
mutation invalidates matching detail/registration entries, preserves public list and rejects stale in-flight data
Kids deduplicates concurrent readers but reopens with a fresh editable profile snapshot
failed requests are retryable; aborted consumers cannot consume even a cached private response
